notes:
{大皿|おおざら} are large plates or platters used for serving food family-style. In Japanese dining, dishes are often placed in the center of the table for everyone to share.

Common uses:
- {大皿|おおざら}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (food served family-style)
- {大皿|おおざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ (to arrange on a large platter)

Size note: {大皿|おおざら} are typically 25cm or larger in diameter. They are common in ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ and for home entertaining.
